title: build(deps-dev): bump @types/three from 0.185.4 to 0.186.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. Typings-only devDependency @types/three 0.185.4 -> 0.186.0 in packages/client; closes the known lag recorded in three-0.186.1-bump.json (runtime three is already ^0.186.1). Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001).
behavior_change: none in the shipped app: @types/* is compile-time only and is not bundled. Lockfile audited against merge base 073a7fb4 by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count 400 before and 400 after; zero added, zero removed. Exactly 1 version change: node_modules/@types/three 0.185.4 -> 0.186.0 (version, resolved, integrity, and its own dependency range fflate ~0.8.2 -> ~0.8.3). That range change moves nothing: node_modules/fflate resolves to 0.8.3 both before and after. The root entry differs only in devDependencies.@types/three. The remaining 16 touched entries change only the `peer` flag (e.g. vue/typescript/vite/eslint drop peer:true; vue-eslint-parser and 3 of its nested deps plus @types/esrecurse gain it). This is npm-version lockfile normalization: running local npm 11.6.1 `install --package-lock-only` on the PR tree flips exactly those 16 flags back, so neither state is a fixed point across npm versions. The flag only affects `npm ci --omit=peer`, which no workflow, Dockerfile or client script uses, so it is installation-inert. Consumers: components/cam/ToolpathCanvas3D.vue (live) and components/cam/CamBackplot3D.vue import three; CI type-check ratchet holds with the new typings.
